WITH person_info_mini_biography AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(info) AS mini_biography
  FROM person_info
  WHERE info_type_id = (SELECT id FROM info_type WHERE info = 'mini biography')
  GROUP BY person_id
), cast_info_features AS (
  SELECT movie_id, person_id
  FROM cast_info
  INNER JOIN movie_link ON ci.movie_id = ml.linked_movie_id
  INNER JOIN link_type ON lt.id = ml.link_type_id AND lt.link = 'features'
), aka_name_person AS (
  SELECT person_id, name
  FROM aka_name
  WHERE name LIKE '%a%'
)
SELECT of_person.name, biography_movie.title
FROM aka_name_person AS of_person
JOIN name ON of_person.person_id = name.id
JOIN person_info_mini_biography ON name.id = person_info_mini_biography.person_id AND person_info_mini_biography.mini_biography = 'Volker Boehm'
JOIN cast_info_features ON name.id = cast_info_features.person_id
JOIN title ON cast_info_features.movie_id = title.id
WHERE name.name_pcode_cf LIKE 'D%'
AND name.gender='m'
AND title.production_year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1984
